visual_review.notes: Reviewed every take by contact strip. Idle, hit and defend were retaken with steady light because the first idle and defend went dark midway and the first hit strobed dark every twelve frames; the first defend also flung a lantern loose. The retaken hit starts after its opening frames, which hold the reference pose and a lantern floating loose. The defend skips two frames where a lantern flies loose. The ranged throw drops the one frame where the lantern leaves the canvas and releases on the empty-hand frame. The skate loops video 32-93 every second frame. Walk, attack, ranged, cast and death are first takes.
